types.label: Recorder (Live fixture)
types.description: Emits each .wav that appears in the folder as a recording: its name, its file and its length (WI-0022-13's e2e).

types.label: Copy off the recorder (Live fixture)
types.description: Says it is copying (status phase copying) until <name>.copied appears in the folder, then copied, and passes the recording on.

types.label: Work on it (Live fixture)
types.description: Reports progress until <name>.worked appears (done, with a result line) or <name>.fail (an error).
